I.
Dei opus est, & bene facere omnia, & quae bene facta sunt,
recte curare. Ideo Deus non tantum κτιστὴς Creator, sed etiam
προνοητὴς Curator & Provisor omnium est. Neque enim mo-
men-

page.notes: Marginal note in left margin reads "Deus creator, idem rerum omnium a se creatarum provisor est." Greek words in the final paragraph are transcribed approximately. The first letter D of "Dei" is a large initial, joined in the transcription. Final word "men-" is a line-end hyphenation.
